# Pull request boarding pass 🏴‍☠️

## Validation 🧪

List checks actually run, their outcomes, and relevant skips. Choose checks from the [testing guide](../docs/development/maraudarr/testing.md); documentation edits do not require live VPN tests. Live tests and reset commands require an explicitly isolated disposable environment.

- [ ] Changed documentation follows GitHub/ISO reader outcomes; duplicate content, links/anchors, and rendered task paths were reviewed.
- [ ] No real credentials, VPN files, private logs, generated `.env`, or application state are included.
